//types: Only @types/node. vitest/globals is deliberately absent: tests import describe/it/expect explicitly, and two that reached for beforeEach without importing it were made to import it, so there is one way to say it rather than two.
//: A second typecheck pass that includes the tests.
`npm run typecheck` covers src/ only, so the 377-test suite has never been type
checked: vitest transpiles without checking, and every test would still pass with a
wrong argument type. Adding this pass found 33 errors across 8 files -- none of them
a behaviour bug, all of them places where a test was asserting something the types
said could not happen. That is exactly the class of error a test suite should not be
able to contain silently, so this is wired into `npm run typecheck`.
`allowJs` is on because several tests import the repository's verification tools
plain JavaScript with JSDoc. Without it each import is an implicit `any`, which is
the one thing worth eliminating: a test that imports a gate should get the gate's
real signature, not silence. `checkJs` stays off so the tools are read for their
types rather than linted as a second codebase.
